d:
Finding Bigfoot Season 2 ventures deep into remote backcountry where eyewitnesses report towering silhouettes, massive footprints, and spine-tingling calls in the dead of night. Witness the boldest moments of this Bigfoot documentary series as investigators analyse startling Bigfoot evidence and experience heart-pounding Bigfoot encounters that keep the Bigfoot mystery alive.
Watch Finding Bigfoot Season 2 (Episodes 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 & 15) on Discovery Channel India.
